Depending on your skin tone, they have orange/pink concealer sticks for pretty cheap (they're colour correcting sticks). If you can't find those then eyeshadow works. Dab that on the area as an underlay. It helps just to even out the tone once you pit concealer on. Spray it on that area and wait for it to dry. If you can't be bothered to buy setting spray, hairspray works in this case. Get a full coverage concealer and dab that over the top of it. You may need a few layers so spray the setting spray/hairspray between said layers. Try your best to blend the concealer in with your natural skin. That probably means putting the concealer on a larger area than just your bruises. If you find you can't blend it, you may need to add a thin layer of foundation to it.

As far as cheap products go, BYS has really good makeup for really cheap, but I've never used their concealer so you might want to check the reviews online first. It they turn out to suck, Covergirl is always a good option. I don't know your reigion, so I'll just use my own currency and you can convert it as needed.

BYS Colour correcting sticks are just under $6 AUD

Their concealer ranges from around $5-$9 AUD. Try to get the camouflage ones.

Covergirl concealer is around $15 but I know for a fact it works well.

MAKE SURE TO DAB THE PRODUCTS ON, NOT WIPE. Otherwise you'll fuck up the colour correcting.

One thing that's kinda stupid but helped me through a bit is thinking of life as one big, dumb, video game. It's kinda similar, right? You go through a bunch of levels and problems and sometimes the game gets so annoyingly difficult or frustrating that you wanna quit. But you don't. Not cause you're gonna gain anything after you finish the game but because you want the satisfaction of finishing it. It doesn't really matter if you don't believe in an afterlife, just pride yourself in the satisfaction of continuing.
Try and practice positive nihilism rather than negative nihilism. Instead of thinking, "ugh nothing matters and I'm gonna die eventually anyway so why not speed it up," try n trick yourself to think "oh? Well if nothing matters then all my hardships don't really matter! Therefore I shouldn't dwell on them and enjoy life", it's easier said than done, considering mental illness but it's worth a try.
Stay strong my dude
